Privacy
policy.

A clear explanation of how website inquiries, technical logs and cookie preferences are handled.

01 / Scope02 / Data processed03 / Cookies04 / Your rights05 / Contact
01 / SCOPE

Website privacy

This notice covers interactions with the Chuhay Systems website, including contact inquiries, consent choices and essential technical logs. Contact form submissions are processed by FormSubmit and delivered to the designated Chuhay Systems email account.

02 / DATA

Data processed

  • [ A ] Contact identity: name, organization and email.
  • [ B ] Inquiry context: selected role and submitted project brief.
  • [ C ] Essential diagnostics: security, availability and consent state.
03 / COOKIES

Cookie control

Cookies are limited to essential operation, security and remembered consent. Analytics or third-party tracking remain disabled unless separately disclosed and authorized.

04 / RIGHTS

Your controls

You may request access, correction or deletion of personal data, withdraw consent, object to processing or request information about retention and safeguards, subject to applicable law.

05 / CONTACT

Privacy inquiry

Select “Privacy / Data rights” in the contact form and include only the information needed to identify and process your request.
